record.paper_title: Open problems in billiards and quantitative symplectic geometry
record.original_question: For polygonal symplectic billiards, label the polygon sides and encode each trajectory by the sequence of side labels it visits. What is the complexity function p(n), the number of distinct length-n subwords that occur in these trajectory codes, and how does it grow?

evidence.quote: Study this function for polygonal symplectic billiards.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P$ be a convex polygon in the plane with sides labeled $s_1, s_2, \dots, s_k$. The symplectic billiard map inside $P$ is defined as follows: given an ordered pair of boundary points $(x, y)$, the image is the pair $(y, z)$, where $z$ is the unique boundary point such that the chord $xz$ is parallel to the side of $P$ containing $y$ (with $z$ chosen on the appropriate side, according to orientation). To each orbit $(x_0, x_1), (x_1, x_2), (x_2, x_3), \dots$ associate the symbolic itinerary $(\ell_0, \ell_1, \ell_2, \dots)$, where $\ell_i \in \{s_1, \dots, s_k\}$ is the label of the side of $P$ containing $x_i$.

Define the complexity function $p(n)$ to be the number of distinct words of length $n$ over the alphabet $\{s_1, \dots, s_k\}$ that occur as a factor of the symbolic itinerary of some orbit of the symplectic billiard in $P$.

Determine the function $p(n)$ and its asymptotic growth rate as $n \to \infty$, in terms of the geometry of $P$ (number of sides, rationality of the polygon, etc.).
artifact.status_search_result: While the complexity function for ordinary (Birkhoff) polygonal billiards has been extensively studied — with cubic upper and lower bounds in the rational case and known cubic growth in tiling cases — the analogous question for polygonal symplectic billiards (introduced in 2017 and further studied in 2019) does not appear to have been resolved. Recent work continues to study the dynamics of polygonal symplectic billiards, but no published determination of the complexity function for this system was found.

status_evidence.title: Polygonal symplectic billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces and studies polygonal symplectic billiards, focusing on orbits in polygons; does not resolve complexity function.
status_evidence.claim: Polygonal symplectic billiards have been introduced and their orbits studied, but the symbolic complexity function is not determined.

status_evidence.title: Complexity and growth for polygonal billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes cubic upper and lower bounds for the complexity function of polygonal (Birkhoff) billiards.
status_evidence.claim: Complexity results exist for ordinary polygonal billiards, providing the analogous context but not addressing the symplectic case.

status_evidence.title: On the complexity of polygonal billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work refining cubic growth of complexity for typical polygons in the Birkhoff setting.
status_evidence.claim: Activity continues on complexity for Birkhoff polygonal billiards; analogous symplectic result not found.
